title: Look Before You Judge: Training-Free Region Mining for Grounded and Explainable Deepfake Detection
title_zh: 先看再判：面向可解释深度伪造检测的无训练区域挖掘
abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can explain deepfake verdicts in natural language, but such explanations are not necessarily visually grounded in the visual evidence underlying the prediction. A model may describe plausible artifacts inferred from language priors rather than from image evidence. Existing grounding methods improve visual reliance through decoding or attention interventions, but they generally strengthen grounding over the entire image, making them ill-suited for forensic artifacts that are subtle, spatially localized, and image-dependent. We propose Look Before You Judge, a training-free framework that formulates explainable deepfake detection as a sequential evidence acquisition process. Instead of directly predicting image authenticity from holistic visual reasoning, our framework first identifies image-specific candidate evidence regions by contrasting the MLLM's decoder-to-visual attention between an original image and its Gaussian-blurred counterpart. The identified regions are then inspected individually, and the resulting local evidence is integrated with the global image context before reaching a final verdict. The framework operates without manipulation masks, external forensic models, or parameter updates, making it directly applicable to off-the-shelf MLLMs. Across five open-source MLLMs on TriDF and MMTD-Set, our framework improves detection accuracy by up to 12.8%, reduces CHAIR by up to 33.4% and hallucination rate by up to 21.3%, and outperforms representative training-free decoding and attention methods.
abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能用自然语言解释深度伪造的判定结果，但这些解释未必在视觉上真正基于预测所依赖的视觉证据。模型可能根据语言先验推断出看似合理的伪影，而非来自图像证据。现有的 grounding 方法通过解码或注意力干预来提升视觉依赖，但通常是在整幅图像上增强 grounding，因此不适合处理细微、空间局部化且依赖图像的取证伪影。我们提出“先看再判”（Look Before You Judge），一个无训练框架，将可解释深度伪造检测建模为顺序证据获取过程。该框架不直接通过整体视觉推理预测图像真实性，而是先通过对比原始图像与高斯模糊版本在 MLLM 解码器到视觉注意力上的差异，识别出图像特定的候选证据区域。然后逐一检查这些区域，并将得到的局部证据与全局图像上下文整合，再做出最终判定。该框架无需操纵掩码、外部取证模型或参数更新，可直接应用于现成的 MLLM。在 TriDF 和 MMTD-Set 上，跨五个开源 MLLM，我们的框架将检测准确率提升最高达 12.8%，将 CHAIR 降低最高达 33.4%，将幻觉率降低最高达 21.3%，并优于代表性的无训练解码和注意力方法。
tldr_zh: 无训练框架先定位证据区域再判定，提升深度伪造检测可解释性。
cover_zh: 先看再判｜这个无训练框架让深度伪造检测不再瞎猜
